title: Framed Payment Form Fix

sections.name: Automatic checkout
items: Fixed the Illegal invocation error that occurred after selecting Credit/Debit Card.
Card number, CVV, expiration month, and expiration year now use the Pokémon Center payment frame's own browser context.
Automatic checkout continues to review after the framed card controls are filled.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
